subject: ddl: remove `mock.Context` usage in `addIndexIngestWorker` (#53479)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for DDL add-index ingest/backfill session initialization changes. The change removes per-worker `sessionctx/mock.Context` usage from `addIndexIngestWorker` by threading explicit `*time.Location`, `errctx.Context`, and per-worker `WriteStmtBufs` into `writeChunkToLocal`/`buildHandle`/`GenIndexKVIter`, while centralizing reorg SQLMode/timezone/err-level helpers in `reorg.go` and adjusting `newSessCtx/initSessCtx` signatures. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in index KV generation correctness, reorg metadata/state-machine behavior, or concurrency handling in the touched DDL ingest path.
